hooks.name: C# Check on Edit
hooks.description: Check C# files for obvious issues when edited and saved

action.prompt: A C# source file was just saved. Check for any obvious issues: missing null checks (CS8600), unused variables, potential NullReferenceException, TreatWarningsAsErrors violations, or obvious logic errors. Flag them if found. This project has TreatWarningsAsErrors enabled and Nullable reference types enabled.
